study type: Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic (PBPK) Modeling and Simulation Study
cohort: The study focused on pediatric patients with varying degrees of renal impairment (RI).
finding: The PBPK model accurately predicted Linezolid exposure in pediatric patients with varying degrees of renal impairment and proposed optimized dosing regimens for those with severe or end-stage renal impairment to achieve therapeutic targets.
